limitations: Finite-input equivalence to existing student arithmetic, not native quality.
Complete student graph timings exclude D3D12 integration and do not accelerate native NVIDIA execution.
Exact full-image results cover only the checked checkpoints, inputs and environment.
No candidate meets native image quality. Native latency remains about 5.4 ms.
Feature-space PCA and affine projection bounds use native targets; they are not deployable RGB predictors.
PCA and the position template are fitted on training targets only. Per-image channel means are oracle native statistics.
Feature pretraining uses six images, and RGB training uses 34. Both stages use static first-reset sample frames.
The staged candidate has 1500 extra pretraining steps, so its comparison to 4500-step RGB training is not compute-matched.
Validation cases stay out of fitting, but their scores inform research choices and are not an independent final quality set.
All image comparisons and timing gains concern experimental student execution, not native NVIDIA execution.
Full 1080p student-plus-grade graph timings exclude application integration. Exactness applies to checked cases, not every possible input or device.
New output fusion stays disabled by default. The checked wider model retains its final decoder projection position.
No sample or game launches, no game/driver/native model or normal runtime changes.
